description: National Police Commission - Delegation of powers by the National Police Commission
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the delegation of powers by the National Police Commission to various ranks of police officers (Inspector General of Police, Senior Deputy Inspector Generals, etc.). It details powers related to appointments, promotions, transfers, disciplinary control, and dismissal within the police force. This content falls squarely under the "Judicial/Law Enforcement Gazettes" category (Type 9), which is defined for matters concerning police and security force appointments, law enforcement regulations, and procedures.
